prompt: Mass Effect 2 once won the D.I.C.E. Award for Game of the Year. Who was the director for the game that won the same award twelve years earlier?
answer: The game that won the D.I.C.E. Award for Game of the Year twelve years before *Mass Effect 2* was *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* (1999). Its director was **Shigeru Miyamoto**.
